load_cityscapes_panoptic: load Cityscapes panoptic segmentation dataset from image and annotation directories into Detectron2 standard format
get_cityscapes_panoptic_files: get a list of Cityscapes panoptic image and label file paths from a directory and JSON info
register_all_cityscapes_panoptic: register all Cityscapes panoptic train and val splits to the Detectron2 DatasetCatalog with metadata
review_load_cityscapes_panoptic: review the load_cityscapes_panoptic function to understand how it converts category IDs and builds dataset dicts
refactor_register_all_cityscapes_panopti: refactor register_all_cityscapes_panoptic to support additional Cityscapes panoptic dataset splits or custom root paths
